notes.title: 1.0.4 version is out now. Balance changes
notes.content:
[h3]Added[/h3]
- Balance fix to prevent stacking leaves on top of each other. Now income is not just halfed once, but halfed each time there's new bush of leaves that's too close.
- Smooth transition between scenes
- Now showing autosave when it's happening (every minute)
[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Bigger game control buttons
- Bigger energy counter to fit more numbers
- UI scaling for better visibility on resolutions bigger than FullHD
- Updated text for options close button when game is running
- Transition to menu now waits for any ongoing file saving processes to wait
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Color dropdown issue not showing selected color first time after game start
- Some branches not changing color after recreating main menu tree
- Performance fix for branches thickening when there's a lot of them
- Fixed some branches thickness bugging when reseting tree in main menu
- Fixes for android compatibility
- Fix for tooltip X position when UI is scaled and tooltip touches horisontal left/right side of the screen

notes.title: 1.0.3 version is out now
notes.content:
[h3]Added[/h3]
- Tree branches can now grow in thickness depending on amount of child branches
- New achievement
[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Changed display layer for bushes coverage for better visibility with thick branches.
- Showing more info in energy counter tooltip
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Issue with camera not finishing movement after jump buttons press.
- Performance fix for branches that reached max length
